exposure: 4-dimensional images of the levator ani hiatus
4-dimensional images of the levator ani muscle
outcome: Reasons for nonqualification (image acquisition error, measurement error, reconstruction error)
cohort: Postpartum women recruited between September 2020 and September 2021 from 44 Chinese tertiary medical centers.
finding: The overall qualified rate of transperineal ultrasound (TPUS) examinations in Chinese tertiary medical centers ranged from 12.00% to 86.92%, with varying qualified rates for different image parts and main reasons for nonqualification being errors in image acquisition, measurement, and reconstruction.
